text: PR #129 (job 20261010-154004-60r4) fails CI's 'the full history' check: its new rule marks a bound-only cost score provisional, and 'athena check --history' now finds 8 existing score files (e.g. records/jobs/2026-10/20261013-141005-hrdp/score.json) that do not follow from their records because they predate the rule. Make the rule hold without invalidating history written before it, without hand-editing records, and make a change to scoring rules get checked against the full history before it lands.
